_comment: Fixture manifest — PR2's validator tests consume this. Keys are paths relative to this directory. 'lenient'/'strict' list the exact finding codes each tier must produce for that file (order-insensitive, exact set). 'full_finding' pins the complete serialized Finding element for one fixture (devex blocker: codes-as-API needs the machine carrier asserted, not just the code).

finding.message: status 'bananas' is not valid for type 'knowledge' (canonical: current, stale, superseded, archived; accepted legacy: active, draft)

legacy/claudlobby-style.md._comment: The adoption case: a real claudlobby fleet doc warns, never errors, in lenient mode (W102 legacy status active->current; W101 missing updated). In strict, the same two codes are emitted with severity 'error' — codes keep their identity across tiers; severity changes.
